units.source_text: 按佛教的说法：往生极乐世界，分上中下三品，每品又分上生、中生、下生，故共有九品。

en.t: According to Buddhist teaching, rebirth in the Land of Ultimate Bliss is divided into three grades: upper, middle, and lower; each grade is further divided into upper birth, middle birth, and lower birth, making nine ranks in all.
The highest of these is upper birth in the upper grade.
